description: Source code for the RustValuesGenerator class, which handles Rust-specific build configuration in a build system, including target validation, crate name/type/root, and dependencies.

classes.name: RustValuesGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Rust build configuration values based on target and scope information.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of validating target type and filling in Rust-specific configuration values.

methods.name: FillCrateName
methods.description: Sets the crate name from scope or defaults to target label name.

methods.name: FillCrateType
methods.description: Sets the crate type based on scope value or defaults based on target type.

methods.name: FillCrateRoot
methods.description: Determines the crate root source file, either from scope or by default.

methods.name: FillAliasedDeps
methods.description: Processes aliased dependencies from scope and adds them to the target's rust values.
